verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims enterprise SCIM and directory sync, and community commenters independently list SAML/SCIM among its features, noting some are enterprise-only. There is no dedicated SCIM documentation in the pack, so user/group sync mechanics and deprovisioning behavior are unproven. Missing for 10: dedicated SCIM plugin/endpoint docs, documented group provisioning, evidence that IdP deprovisioning revokes sessions/app access, hands-on corroboration, and clarity on which tier includes SCIM.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access

citations.quote: SSO, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and directory sync.
acting as an identity provider and OIDC/SSO provider, RBAC, and SAML/SCIM. Some of those features are enterprise-only.
